description: This is a Java source file defining the DbUtil class, which provides utility methods for creating and managing a database connection for testing purposes within the OpenMRS project. It includes logic for setting up test databases, handling both MySQL and PostgreSQL, and configuring connection properties.

classes.name: DbUtil
classes.description: A utility class for creating and configuring test databases in the OpenMRS project. Supports MySQL and PostgreSQL, ensuring the database exists and setting up necessary schema and connection properties.

methods.name: ensureDatabaseCreated
methods.description: Public method to ensure the test database is created and ready for use. Calls internal methods to create the database if it does not already exist, and initializes schema via Liquibase.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Private method that sets database connection parameters based on system properties, determines the database type (MySQL or PostgreSQL), and creates the database if necessary.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Private helper method that executes the SQL statement to create the database using JDBC.

methods.name: getConnectionUrl
methods.description: Private method returning the JDBC connection URL template based on the database type (MySQL or PostgreSQL).
